name: Wakasugi Tsuzura
source:
Tsuzura had settled in at Kei's Father's house. 
Perhaps in the spirit of her family tradition, "survival of the fittest," a girl of young body and stature on a journey by herself. Even at an age nearly half of [url=/c10490]Kei[/url]'s, she is remarkably level-headed. Currently living her tough-as-nails lifestyle with her partner, the white fox Obana, in Kei's father's uninhabited house.

[Taken from [url=http://akaiitotranslation.com/info/characters/tsudzura.php]Zohar's site[/url].]
